panels.description:
Percentage of remaining I/O capacity that is available for Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) volumes attached to the RDS instance.

If the EBS Byte Balance % gets low (close to 0%), it suggests that the database is pushing the storage to its limits in terms of read/write operations, which could result in slower performance or potential throttling if the I/O request rate exceeds the available capacity.
panels.title: EBS Byte Balance %

panels.description: Low EBS IO Balance % indicates that the volume is using more I/O than its baseline and is running low on credits. When this happens, the volume will be throttled back to its baseline performance, which can negatively affect the application's performance.
panels.title: EBS IO Balance %
